text_block_list.text:
I ended up tagging along for Maruzensky's 
independent dance practice.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
So you're accompanying me for today's 
lesson, Trainer-kun. Fufu, I'm glad♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
So you're accompanying me for today's 
lesson, Trainer-chan. Fufu, I'm glad♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"I'll show you that running isn't my only 
weapon!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"I'll show you that running isn't my only 
weapon!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's go all-out and hype it 
up~♪ Keep your eyes on me, Trainer-kun!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's go all-out and hype it 
up~♪ Keep your eyes on me, Trainer-chan!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Alright, one, two, three, four! Yeah, 
yeah♪ Whoo, whoo♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Right? I'm getting into the groove now!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Still... to be honest, I feel like it's 
missing that classic staple move for 
dancing."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Look, it's that thing. What was it called 
again...? A folding fan with fluffy 
feathers on it.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
If we have that, don't you think we could 
pull off an even more upbeat and hyped 
dance?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
If we have that, don't you think we could 
pull off an even more upbeat and hyped 
dance?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Apparently it's trending in the city, 
but maybe you're not familiar with it, 
Trainer-kun?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Apparently it's trending in the city, 
but maybe you're not familiar with it, 
Trainer-chan?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! Let's do this! It's just an 
optional practice today, but let's change 
things up a bit...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'll teach you the latest trendy dance, 
Trainer-kun♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'll teach you the latest trendy dance, 
Trainer-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I mean, look, usually you're the one 
teaching me all sorts of things, right?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I mean, look, usually you're the one 
teaching me all sorts of things, right?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Except today, it's my turn to teach you. 
Fufu, I'm actually getting kind of 
excited♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's keep going with dance 
practice~.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna keep picking up the pace, so 
keep your eyes glued on me, okay?

Even after that, Maruzensky treated me to 
a display of her razor-sharp dance moves.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hoo-hoo♪ Keep on enjoying yourselves, 
okay~♪

A strange sense of nostalgia washed over 
me, while Maruzensky's face beamed 
brightly...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Huh... Nostalgic? Wh-What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"High-energy dances like this are trendy 
with the young crowd, aren't they?"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Because Mom said so. She told me this 
sort of thing is trendy in the city..."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Besides, in that TV drama I watched 
before, there was a scene where everyone 
danced together in a restaurant!
choice_data_list:
The video itself is really old in the 
first place, so...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? That can't be true! I mean, it's a 
videotape of a trendy drama, you know?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
If videotapes aren't trendy, then what on 
earth is?
choice_data_list:
Like watching the latest drama on my 
phone...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
A smartphone can do that too!? No way, I 
had no idea...!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... To be honest, I still don't really 
know how to use it, but...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Still, one day, I'm totally gonna master 
it and use it like a pro!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: All for the sake of trendy...!

The road ahead still seemed long, but 
Maruzensky's resolve was steadfast...
